newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: FINANCE MINISTRY PLANS LONG-TERM T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: FINANCE MINISTRY PLANS LONG-TERM T-BILLS.

text.p: Lithuania plans a local issue of two-year government T-bills this year and a local issue of five-year maturity securities in 1998, an official at the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
"Our main objective is to extend maturities and to have all kinds of instruments," Ruta Skyriene, deputy director of the finance ministy's international department, told Reuters.
"It's a normal objective for debt management to have longer maturities and more instruments," Skyriene said.
Skyriene said this year's two-year maturity would come after a planned $200 million Eurobond, which Skyriene said was expected in June or July.
"We are planning to do it this year but after the Eurobond," Skyriene said.
Baltic neighbour Latvia launched its first two-year local Treasury bill last month.
